experimental_method: In situ 1H NMR spectroscopy (600 MHz) of CH4 + ultrapure water equilibrated in a sealed high-pressure zirconia NMR tube (1.011 mL); liquid and vapour compositions measured on separate samples, each filling the active volume; liquid samples equilibrated overnight in a rotating oven with glass beads.
uncertainties_stated: T: Cernox sensor calibration 0.36 K plus gradients/offsets, combined standard uncertainty 0.36-0.46 K (Table S1). p: transducer 0.0022 MPa; combined relative standard uncertainty 0.16 % to 0.52 % (Table S2). Composition: combined relative standard uncertainty per setpoint in Table 1 (x_methane 2.89 % to 21.41 %, y_water 8.27 % to 22.77 %).
quality_remarks: Liquid-phase x_methane agrees with literature and Henry's law (authors). Vapour-phase y_water is systematically about half of literature data and of the GERG-2008 / Herrig models; the authors attribute it most likely to NMR peak overlap and say the vapour data are unresolved ('trustworthiness ... unlikely to be resolved without a careful study'). Recommend holding or flagging Table 3. One apparent outlier in each set of repeats at 307.98 K, 6.9 MPa, kept by the authors. The asterisk on the Table 3 pressure header has no printed footnote. Pressures are calculated from the pre-sealing transducer reading with an approximate correction (Eq. 1).
